Before Pilate

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

‘And he answered them nothing.’—M
ARK
 
XV.
 3
.
O 
MIGHTY
 Nothing! unto thee
Nothing, wee owe all things that bee.
God spoke once when Hee all things made,
Hee sav’d all when Hee Nothing said.
The world was made of Nothing then;
’Tis made by Nothing now againe.
